title: Kalshi adds India to growing list of restricted jurisdictions
summary: Kalshi has added India to its list of 55 restricted jurisdictions, months after Indian authorities warned VPN providers to stop facilitating access to these platforms.

title: EU committee advances digital euro bill after key vote
summary: EU lawmakers backed rules for an offline and online digital euro, with privacy safeguards, holding limits and no interest payments.

title: Former BIS chief softens stance on stablecoins, backs coexistence with fiat
summary: Former BIS general manager Agustín Carstens said stablecoins can enhance financial inclusion and innovation but stressed the need for global regulatory frameworks to enable coexistence with fiat money.

title: Binance’s Yi He warns of alleged impersonation scam, CoinUp denies ties
summary: Binance co-founder Yi He warns of an alleged impersonator referred to as “Zhu Pan” in Chinese-language posts as CoinUp distances itself from the individual.

title: Bitcoin gets new $54K warning as BTC price hits 11-day low on Asia tech sell-off
summary: Bitcoin analysis warned of "new lows" as Asia markets dropped as much as 10% and BTC price action dipped below $62,000 for the first time in nearly two weeks.

title: THORChain resumes trading more than month after $10M exploit
summary: THORChain resumed all network activity after implementing multiple security upgrades and a vault migration to fix the vulnerabilities that led to the $10.7 million exploit.

title: Ripple gains preliminary MiCA license ahead of July 1 EU deadline
summary: Ripple secures preliminary CASP approval in Luxembourg ahead of July 1 MiCA deadline as companies race for EU crypto licensing.

summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: US Senate passes housing bill with CBDC ban until 2030
summary: The Senate voted 85-5 to pass a major housing affordability bill that includes a ban on the Federal Reserve making a central bank digital currency until 2030.

title: Crypto lobby urges Congress to pass staking and mining tax bill as is
summary: A trio of crypto lobby groups says a bill allowing staking and mining rewards to be taxed when they’re sold should be passed without further amendments.
